quote: While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
claim: 消融实验显示单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]，减小注意力 key 维度 d_k 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]。

quote: The decoder is also composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器整体结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths, as memory constraints limit batching across examples.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿输入输出序列的符号位置逐步计算，这种固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position.
claim: 对于涉及很长序列的任务，作者提出可将自注意力限制在大小为 r 的邻域内，但这会把最大路径长度增加到 O(n/r)，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该做法 [S4.p4]。

quote: $\displaystyle PE_{(pos,2i)}=sin(pos/10000^{2i/d_{\text{model}}})$
claim: 由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦余弦位置编码以注入位置信息 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS5.p3]。

quote: In model design we follow the original Transformer as closely as possible.
claim: 模型设计尽量贴近原始 Transformer，只使用标准可学习的一维位置嵌入，并可在微调时对预训练位置嵌入做二维插值以适应更高分辨率 [S3.p1][S3.SS1.p3][S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
claim: 方法上，ViT 将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，把得到的向量序列输入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1][S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: ViT uses approximately $2-4\times$ less compute to attain the same performance (average over 5 datasets).
claim: 在性能与计算权衡上，ViT 达到相同性能所需计算约为 ResNet 的 2–4 倍更少，混合模型在小计算预算下略优于纯 ViT，但差距在更大模型上消失 [S4.SS4.p2]。

quote: Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，能否将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像，而不依赖卷积网络或专门的注意力模式 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: the best model reaches the accuracy of $88.55\%$ on ImageNet, $90.72\%$ on ImageNet-ReaL, $94.55\%$ on CIFAR-100, and $77.63\%$ on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
claim: 但在更大数据集（14M–300M 图像）上预训练后，ViT 接近或超过当时最优结果：最佳模型在 ImageNet 达到 88.55%、ImageNet-ReaL 达到 90.72%、CIFAR-100 达到 94.55%、VTAB 19 任务套件达到 77.63% [S1.p5]。

quote: This shows we can update RAG’s world knowledge by simply replacing its non-parametric memory.
claim: RAG 生成比 BART 更多样，且可通过替换非参数记忆更新知识 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1][S4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: RAG can generate correct answers even when the correct answer is not in any retrieved document, achieving 11.8% accuracy in such cases for NQ, where an extractive model would score 0%.
claim: RAG 在正确答案不在任何检索文档中时仍能达到 11.8% 的 NQ 准确率，而抽取式模型为 0% [S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: REALM and ORQA, two recently introduced models that combine masked language models with a differentiable retriever, have shown promising results, but have only explored open-domain extractive question answering.
claim: 作者希望将参数化与非参数化记忆的混合模型从抽取式任务扩展到序列到序列生成模型 [S1.p1]。

quote: RAG-Sequence outperforms BART on Open MS-MARCO NLG by 2.6 Bleu points and 2.6 Rouge-L points.
claim: 在 MS-MARCO NLG 上，RAG-Sequence 比 BART 高 2.6 Bleu 和 2.6 Rouge-L [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: To test RAG’s natural language generation (NLG) in a knowledge-intensive setting, we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.
claim: 实验覆盖开放域问答（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实验证 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: The existence of this constructed solution indicates that a deeper model should produce no higher training error than its shallower counterpart.
claim: 作者指出，按构造存在一个解使更深模型的训练误差不应高于其较浅对应模型，但现有求解器无法找到可比或更好的解 [S1.p4]。

quote: Unexpectedly, such degradation is not caused by overfitting, and adding more layers to a suitably deep model leads to higher training error
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当更深的网络能够开始收敛时，会出现退化问题——随着深度增加，准确率饱和并迅速下降，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起，向适当深的模型添加更多层会导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。

quote: The original mapping is recast into $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$.
claim: 论文提出深度残差学习框架：不期望每几个堆叠层直接拟合目标底层映射 H(x)，而是显式地让这些层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原始映射被重铸为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。

quote: The learning rate starts from 0.1 and is divided by 10 when the error plateaus, and the models are trained for up to $60\times 10^{4}$ iterations.
claim: 训练设置包括：随机采样短边在 [256,480] 的图像、224×224 裁剪、逐像素均值减法、标准颜色增强、每个卷积后激活前使用批归一化、SGD 小批量 256、学习率从 0.1 开始并在误差平台时除以 10、训练最多 60×10^4 次迭代、权重衰减 0.0001、动量 0.9、不使用 dropout [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: We use a weight decay of 0.0001 and a momentum of 0.9. We do not use dropout, following the practice in.
claim: 训练设置包括：随机采样短边在 [256,480] 的图像、224×224 裁剪、逐像素均值减法、标准颜色增强、每个卷积后激活前使用批归一化、SGD 小批量 256、学习率从 0.1 开始并在误差平台时除以 10、训练最多 60×10^4 次迭代、权重衰减 0.0001、动量 0.9、不使用 dropout [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: DeepSeek-R1-Zero increasingly exhibits advanced reasoning strategies such as reflective reasoning and systematic exploration of alternative solutions
claim: 训练过程中，模型自然涌现出反思、验证和探索替代方案等高级推理行为，并出现“aha moment” [S2.SS3.p5]。

quote: On the Codeforces platform, DeepSeek-R1 outperforms 96.3% of human participants, underscoring its advanced problem-solving capabilities.
claim: DeepSeek-R1 在数学任务上与 OpenAI-o1-1217 表现相当，在 Codeforces 上超越 96.3% 的人类参与者 [A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p3][A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p4]。

quote: we aim to explore the potential of LLMs for developing reasoning abilities through self-evolution in an RL framework, with minimal reliance on human labeling efforts.
claim: 论文旨在探索大语言模型能否通过强化学习自我演化来发展推理能力，从而最小化对人类标注的依赖 [S1.p2]。

quote: during training, DeepSeek-R1-Zero exhibits an “aha moment” (Table 2), characterized by a sudden increase in the use of the word “wait” during reflections
claim: 训练过程中，模型自然涌现出反思、验证和探索替代方案等高级推理行为，并出现“aha moment” [S2.SS3.p5]。

quote: we introduce DeepSeek-R1, a model trained through a multi-stage learning framework that integrates rejection sampling, reinforcement learning, and supervised fine-tuning
claim: 对于 DeepSeek-R1，采用多阶段框架，整合拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调，并引入语言一致性奖励以缓解语言混杂问题 [S1.p3][S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: However, it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it.
claim: 作者明确承认 budget forcing 在进一步扩展时有两个关键限制：性能最终会趋于平坦，且受底层语言模型上下文窗口约束 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Training on our full data pool of 59K examples, a superset of s1K, does not offer substantial gains over our 1K selection.
claim: 数据消融显示，随机选择、仅多样性或仅最长轨迹都明显更差（AIME24 平均约 -30%），而全量 59K 相比 1K 没有实质增益 [S1.p3]。

quote: We find that s1-32B is the most sample-efficient open data reasoning model.
claim: 它是样本效率最高的开放数据推理模型，仅用 1,000 条样本就显著优于基座 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Only Quality (1K-random): After obtaining our high-quality reasoning chains from Gemini, we select 1,000 samples at random
claim: 消融实验分别检验数据选择（随机、仅多样性、仅最长、全量 59K）和测试时扩展方法（budget forcing、token/step/class-conditional control、rejection sampling）[S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: we suppress the generation of the end-of-thinking token delimiter and optionally append the string “Wait” to the model’s current reasoning trace
claim: 测试时使用 budget forcing：超过上限时强制插入思考结束符提前退出，想延长时抑制结束符并追加“Wait”鼓励反思 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: we compare two 32B-parameter models: Qwen1.5-32B-Chat and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct (LIMO’s base model).
claim: 分析实验还比较了不同推理链质量 L1–L5、不同问题难度 Simple-500/Complex-500/Advanced-500、不同预训练模型 Qwen1.5-32B-Chat 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct、不同模型规模 3B–72B，以及 400 到 2,000 条样本的数据规模 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p1][S6.SS3.SSS4.p1][S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: OpenThoughts-114k achieves suboptimal results (58.3%) probably due to unfocused problem selection.
claim: 与更大数据集相比，NuminaMath-100k 显著退化至 32.3%，低于基座模型的 49.9%，OpenThoughts-114k 为 58.3%，而 LIMO 的 800 题达到 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: CHMath (2024 Chinese High School Mathematics League), Gaokao (China’s 2024 College Entrance Exam), Kaoyan (Chinese Graduate School Entrance Exams), and GradeSchool
claim: 论文在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500、AMC23 上评估，并设置分布外评估，包括 OlympiadBench、中文新构建的 CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool，以及多学科基准 Minerva 和 GPQA [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Future work could explore active learning strategies to further optimize sample efficiency.
claim: 此外，作者提出未来工作可探索主动学习策略以进一步优化样本效率 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: Complex reasoning has long been considered one of the most challenging capabilities to instill in large language models (LLMs).
claim: 作者指出，传统范式基于两个假设——掌握复杂认知过程需要大量监督示范，且监督微调主要导致记忆而非真正泛化 [S1.p1]。

quote: Without SWE-agent’s file editor interface, performance drops to ( $10.3$ % $\downarrow$ 7.7).
claim: 消融显示，使用迭代搜索接口时性能反而比没有额外搜索工具更差（15.7% 降至 12.0%）[S5.SS1.p3]；没有文件编辑器接口时性能降至 10.3% [S5.SS1.p4]；没有 linting 时性能为 15.0% [S5.SS1.p5]。

quote: This intervention improves performance considerably (without linting, $15.0$ % $\downarrow$ 3.0).
claim: 消融显示，使用迭代搜索接口时性能反而比没有额外搜索工具更差（15.7% 降至 12.0%）[S5.SS1.p3]；没有文件编辑器接口时性能降至 10.3% [S5.SS1.p4]；没有 linting 时性能为 15.0% [S5.SS1.p5]。

quote: we introduce SWE-agent, an agent composed of an LM and ACI, that can interact with a computer to solve challenging real-world software engineering problems
claim: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 和 ACI 组成的 agent，可与计算机交互解决真实软件工程问题 [S1.p3]。

quote: SWE-agent yields strong performance on HumanEvalFix with $88.3$ % pass@1 rate.
claim: 在 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 取得 88.3% 的 pass@1 率 [S5.p2]。

quote: We also test SWE-agent’s basic code editing abilities with HumanEvalFix, a short-form code debugging benchmark.
claim: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包仓库的 2,294 个任务实例；消融和分析在 SWE-bench Lite 上进行，这是包含 300 个实例的规范子集，聚焦自包含的功能性 bug 修复 [S4.p1]。

quote: To reduce variance, we apply a teacher-forcing trick to include in the loss the likelihood of predicting not only the token after the thought but also later tokens.
claim: 方法包含三个主要步骤：在输入序列的 n 个 token 上并行生成 r 个长度为 t 的理由，并用可学习的 <|startofthought|> 和 <|endofthought|> token 标记起止 [S4.SS1.p1]；用混合头（浅层 MLP）输出权重，决定后理由预测 logits 与基础语言模型 logits 的混合程度 [S4.SS1.p1]；用 REINFORCE 优化理由生成参数，奖励为某条理由下真实后续 token 的对数似然与所有理由平均对数似然之差 [S4.SS4.SSS3.p1][S4.SS4.SSS3.p2]。

quote: We use REINFORCE to optimize the likelihoods of the rationales based on their usefullness
claim: 方法包含三个主要步骤：在输入序列的 n 个 token 上并行生成 r 个长度为 t 的理由，并用可学习的 <|startofthought|> 和 <|endofthought|> token 标记起止 [S4.SS1.p1]；用混合头（浅层 MLP）输出权重，决定后理由预测 logits 与基础语言模型 logits 的混合程度 [S4.SS1.p1]；用 REINFORCE 优化理由生成参数，奖励为某条理由下真实后续 token 的对数似然与所有理由平均对数似然之差 [S4.SS4.SSS3.p1][S4.SS4.SSS3.p2]。

quote: we introduce an auxiliary ‘rationale’ variable between each pair of observed tokens of the sequence.
claim: Quiet-STaR 在每对观测 token 之间引入辅助的“理由”变量，目标是优化模型生成中间思考以更好地预测剩余序列 [S3.p1]。

quote: We insert learned <| startofthought |> and <| endofthought |> tokens to mark each rationale’s start and end.
claim: 方法包含三个主要步骤：在输入序列的 n 个 token 上并行生成 r 个长度为 t 的理由，并用可学习的 <|startofthought|> 和 <|endofthought|> token 标记起止 [S4.SS1.p1]；用混合头（浅层 MLP）输出权重，决定后理由预测 logits 与基础语言模型 logits 的混合程度 [S4.SS1.p1]；用 REINFORCE 优化理由生成参数，奖励为某条理由下真实后续 token 的对数似然与所有理由平均对数似然之差 [S4.SS4.SSS3.p1][S4.SS4.SSS3.p2]。

quote: We have also only applied Quiet-STaR to a 7 billion parameter model, albeit a powerful one.
claim: 作者承认，为解决问题所做的简化之一是尚未验证这些技术从零开始训练模型时是否有效 [S6.p1]。

quote: When holding the total number of inference FLOPs constant, we find that on some datasets (e.g. MATH), coverage is maximized with a smaller model and more samples, while on others (e.g CodeContests) it is better to sample fewer times from a larger model.
claim: 在成本方面，固定推理 FLOPs 时最优模型大小因任务而异；在 SWE-bench Lite 上，采样五次较便宜的 DeepSeek 模型比 Claude 或 GPT 单次采样解决更多问题且成本低 3 倍以上 [S1.p9]。

quote: pass@k $\displaystyle=\frac{1}{\text{\# of problems}}\sum_{i=1}^{\text{\# of problems}}\left(1-\frac{\binom{N-C_{i}}{k}}{\binom{N}{k}}\right)$ (1)
claim: 作者用覆盖率（pass@k）衡量生成正确样本的能力，并采用无偏估计公式计算 pass@k [S2.p5][S2.p6]。

quote: In coding settings, our definition of coverage is equivalent to the commonly-used pass@k metric, where $k$ denotes the number of samples per problem.
claim: 作者用覆盖率（pass@k）衡量生成正确样本的能力，并采用无偏估计公式计算 pass@k [S2.p5][S2.p6]。

quote: While success rates initially increase with the number of samples for all three methods, they plateau around 100 samples.
claim: 但在没有自动验证器的数学文字题中，多数投票和奖励模型在约 100 个样本后趋于饱和，与覆盖率上界的差距随样本数增加而扩大 [S1.p10][S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: When keeping the agent framework (Moatless Tools) constant, sampling five times from the weaker and cheaper DeepSeek model solves more issues than single samples from Claude or GPT while also being over 3x cheaper.
claim: 在成本方面，固定推理 FLOPs 时最优模型大小因任务而异；在 SWE-bench Lite 上，采样五次较便宜的 DeepSeek 模型比 Claude 或 GPT 单次采样解决更多问题且成本低 3 倍以上 [S1.p9]。

quote: We also undertake a systematic study of “data contamination”
claim: 此外，论文还系统研究了数据污染问题，构建了清理后的基准子集来量化其影响 [S1.p15][S4.p5]。

quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves, and occasionally contain non-sequitur sentences or paragraphs.
claim: 作者承认 GPT-3 在文本合成和若干 NLP 任务上仍有明显弱点，例如在文档级别语义重复、长段落失去连贯性、自相矛盾，以及偶尔出现不合逻辑的句子或段落 [S5.p2]。

quote: We typically set $K$ in the range of 10 to 100 as this is how many examples can fit in the model’s context window
claim: 论文在零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置下评估，少样本通常使用 10 到 100 个示例 [S1.p9][S2.p2]。

quote: they are both expensive and inconvenient to perform inference on, which may present a challenge for practical applicability of models of this scale in their current form.
claim: 此外，预训练样本效率差、少样本学习究竟是从头学习还是识别已见任务存在不确定性，以及大模型推理昂贵且不便，都是作者明确承认的局限 [S5.p5][S5.p6][S5.p7]。

quote: humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
claim: 作者指出，人类通常只需少量示例或简单指令就能完成新的语言任务，而当前 NLP 系统在这方面仍存在困难 [abstract][S1.p5]。

quote: Our smaller models are best-in-class, outperforming alternative models with similar numbers of parameters.
claim: 实验评估表明，旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先语言模型表现相当，并接近最先进水平 [S1.p6]。

quote: These models are still under active development and not yet ready for release.
claim: 多模态模型仍在积极开发中，尚未准备好发布 [S1.p8][S2.p6]。

quote: our performance gains are primarily driven by improvements in data quality and diversity as well as by increased training scale.
claim: Llama 3 采用标准的稠密 Transformer 架构，与 Llama 2 相比仅有少量修改，性能提升主要来自数据质量和多样性以及训练规模的增加 [S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: We evaluate the speech understanding capabilities of our speech interface for Llama 3 on three tasks: (1) automatic speech recognition, (2) speech translation, and (3) spoken question answering.
claim: 多模态实验在图像识别、视频识别和语音理解任务上进行了评估 [S7.SS6.p1][S7.SS7.p1][S8.SS4.p1]。

quote: Llama 3 uses a standard, dense Transformer architecture.
claim: Llama 3 采用标准的稠密 Transformer 架构，与 Llama 2 相比仅有少量修改，性能提升主要来自数据质量和多样性以及训练规模的增加 [S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: On MathVista, it achieves a score of 74.8, outperforming the previous open-source state-of-the-art score of 72.3.
claim: 在数学任务上，MathVista 取得 74.8 分，超过此前开源最先进分数 72.3 [S3.SS1.p2]。
